description: Expanded football-auction player pool with 489 players, including 200 additional unique records. Every record contains a direct Wikimedia-hosted image URL. Current-player club and registration status should be checked before any real-world live use. Base prices are editable game-balance points, not market valuations.

categories.Current: Players treated as active in the 2026-27 era; verify roster status before a live event.
categories.Icon: Retired all-time greats and historically elite players.
categories.Hero: Cult heroes, fan favourites and memorable players from club and international football.

auction_rules.price_note: Illustrative starting prices for balancing the game. Tune to your team budget and squad size.

image_policy.description: Every player record has a populated direct HTTP(S) image URL resolved from a Wikipedia PageImages API result. Image URLs point to Wikimedia-hosted image files, not to search pages.
image_policy.provider: Wikimedia-hosted thumbnails discovered using Wikipedia PageImages API
image_policy.frontend_usage: Use when player.image is not null; otherwise show the player's initials or a fallback portrait.
image_policy.reuse_warning: Wikimedia images have file-specific licenses. Check image_file_page_url and comply with its license and attribution conditions before reuse.
image_policy.filter_rule: Only players with a direct image URL are included in this images-only export.
